The '''two-man Imperial scout walker''' was a model of bipedal [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and crewed by a pair of [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. A [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] extended away from its body,<ref name="The Return of Ben Kenobi" /> which featured eight [[Window/Legends|windows]] at the front, plus one long window at the back of the cockpit. The two-man Imperial scout walker could kneel down by having its right [[Limb/Legends|leg]] bend forward and its left leg bend backward.<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back Sketchbook" /> It also featured a [[Floodlight/Legends|floodlight]] and a double-barreled turret atop its body, with another floodlight mounted above its cockpit.<ref name="The Return of Ben Kenobi" />

==Behind the scenes==
The two-man Imperial scout walker was first mentioned in ''[[The Empire Strikes Back Sketchbook]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book written by [[Joe Johnston]] and [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]] and released in [[June]], [[1980]].<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back Sketchbook" /> It was depicted using Johnston's first breakthrough bipedal walker concept developed for the 1980 film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], dated to late [[1977]].<ref name="The Making of The Empire Strikes Back">''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> It was first identified as the two-man Imperial scout walker in the [[Star Wars Scrapbook|''Star Wars'' Scrapbook]] section of the [[Star Wars (comic strip)|newspaper]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic strip]] ''[[The Return of Ben Kenobi]]'', written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and penciled by [[Al Williamson]], which ran from [[May 17]] to [[July 25]], [[1982]].<ref name="The Return of Ben Kenobi" />
